title: The Concrete example from the book
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：concrete　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 concrete 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the baker wrote of ① a concrete example from the book in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more concrete than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the concrete ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most concrete example from the book anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too concrete to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the concrete ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a concrete step by the door, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as concrete as the step by the door they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was concrete or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something concrete, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite concrete; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the concrete ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another concrete example from the book in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more concrete than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most concrete step by the door in the whole bakery, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the concrete ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 具体（前置定语 a concrete example from the book：1977 年面点师在账单里记下的那件具体的实例）
B. adj. 具体／混凝土（比较级 more concrete than：文中两处，一处比书上的实例，一处比预想）
C. adj. 具体／混凝土（最高级 the most concrete：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 具体（表语 too concrete to do：母亲觉得它太具体，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 混凝土（前置定语 a concrete step by the door：叔叔把整件事称作一桩混凝土的台阶）
F. adj. 混凝土（同级比较 as concrete as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩门前的台阶相比）
G. adj. 混凝土（后置定语 something concrete：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 混凝土（受程度副词修饰 quite concrete：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a concrete example from the book
the most concrete example from the book anybody
a concrete step by the door
The most concrete step by the door in

answers.why: concrete 意为“具体”，1977 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件具体的实例”，此处作前置定语 a concrete example from the book。
concrete 意为“具体”，此处用比较级 more concrete than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
concrete 意为“具体”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最具体的一件，故用最高级 the most concrete example from the book。
concrete 意为“具体”，母亲认为这件东西“太具体了，谁也用不上”，too concrete to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
concrete 意为“混凝土”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩混凝土的台阶”，此处作前置定语 a concrete step by the door。
concrete 意为“混凝土”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩门前的台阶一样混凝土”，同级比较用 as concrete as。
concrete 意为“混凝土”，账单上那半行字要的是“混凝土的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something concrete。
concrete 意为“混凝土”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当混凝土”，quite 修饰原级 concrete。
concrete 意为“混凝土”，1987 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要混凝土”，故用比较级 more concrete than。
concrete 意为“混凝土”，母亲 1989 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最混凝土的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most concrete step by the door。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件具体的实例。（a concrete example from the book）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更具体。（more concrete than …）
母亲觉得它太具体，谁也用不上。（too concrete to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩混凝土的台阶。（a concrete step by the door）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩门前的台阶一样混凝土。（as concrete as …）
到了 1984 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件混凝土的东西。（something concrete）
answers: In 1977 the baker wrote of a concrete example from the book in the bill.
Everybody said it was more concrete than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too concrete to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a concrete step by the door.
He said nobody would call it as concrete as the step by the door they had once had.
By 1984 the bill asked for nothing but something concrete.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 concrete 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the baker wrote of a concrete example from the book in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most concrete example from the book in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too concrete to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a concrete step by the door, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite concrete, and everybody laughed.
The concrete ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
